readerCopy.body: A relationship, offer, or money decision can matter because it changes what becomes possible to build around it. When Venus conjoins the North Node, connection and forward movement meet in the same choice, allowing a collaborator, changing relationship, financial commitment, or clearer sense of value to alter the practical shape of the future. Chemistry and pleasure do not prove that every term works. Support that fits the life being built is still useful information.
